name: agent-skills
description: Personal Claude Code skills. Review: self-review (own branch, pre-PR), arch-review (three-lens deep review of one change), guided-review (PR walkthrough, never posts), adversarial-review (skeptical pass, one PR comment), pr-review (rubric pass, inline PR comments). Plus mutation-coverage (mutation testing + test-gap closing) and authoring-skills (skill authoring conventions).
